about.title: Mō Mātou
about.p1: Ko Trillion AI Tech he whare toi hangarau motuhake kei Aotearoa.
about.p2: E hanga ana mātou i ngā taupānga, kēmu, pūnaha tumuaki AI, taputapu, me ngā pūmanawa me te arotahi ki te auaha, te whakamahi, me ngā mātāpono hoahoa hou.
about.p3: Ko tā mātou misioni ko te hanga hangarau e whakamana ana i ngā kaiwhakamahi me te whakapai ake i ō rātou wheako matihiko. E whakapono ana mātou ki te whanaketanga mārama, ngā tikanga AI pono, me te hanga hua e whakatau tika ana i ngā raruraru.
about.notice: Kei te whanaketanga · E hanga ana i te anamata, kotahi hua i te wā.
